sql: SELECT * FROM climate WHERE avail_season=6 ORDER BY avail_t DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT cls, SUM(anglers) anglers, SUM(yt) yt, ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) ypa, COUNT(*) n, MAX(fished_date_doy) last_doy
FROM trips WHERE fished_date_season=6 AND cls IN ('hd_am','hd_pm','three_quarter','full_day','overnight','day_1_5')
GROUP BY cls ORDER BY ypa DESC

SELECT cls, (fished_date_doy/10)*10 doy_bucket, SUM(anglers) anglers, SUM(yt) yt, ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) ypa, COUNT(*) n
FROM trips WHERE fished_date_season=6 AND cls IN ('three_quarter','day_1_5','overnight')
GROUP BY cls, doy_bucket ORDER BY cls, doy_bucket
